description: Booking Holdings Inc. aims to make it easier for everyone to experience the world, providing consumers with a best-in-class experience through tailored planning, payment, language and other options that seamlessly connect them with its travel service provider partners, offered through five primary consumer-facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable, covering accommodations, ground transportation, flights, activities, restaurants and meta search. It derives substantially all of its revenues from providing online travel reservation services that facilitate online travel purchases by travelers from travel service providers, and also earns revenues from payment facilitation, advertising, restaurant reservation and management services, travel-related insurance offerings and other services, reporting revenues of $26.9 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025.
